name: Baxcalibur
description: Baxcalibur, the Ice Dragon Pokémon, and the evolved form of Arctibax. A Dragon and Ice type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
